nom: Naked Sundays CabanaClear Illuminating Water Gel Serum SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-leaning combination skin mostly report the serum does not make them greasy or cause breakouts, though one reviewer felt it sat on top of her skin and stayed oily rather than glowy, and another warns it can turn greasy by the end of oily days or for oilier skin types.
segments.dry: The few reviewers with dry skin report it hydrates and gives a subtle glow without any dryness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one that leans very oily and one also sensitive, report a natural finish with no added shine, breakouts or congestion.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report no irritation, breakouts or congestion, and appreciate calming ingredients like Centella Asiatica.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as hydrating, moisturizing and non-drying, including on dry skin; no reviewer reports it as drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it visually hides redness the way a concealer would, though this is a cosmetic camouflage effect from the tint rather than a treatment claim.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone, including some with a history of breaking out from SPF, consistently report no new breakouts or congestion; no reviewer reports it causing blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including several with oily or oily-leaning skin, report it does not feel greasy or add shine; one reviewer found it stayed oily and sat on top of her skin rather than absorbing, and another cautions it can turn greasy by the end of oily days.

aspects.libelle: Leaves no white cast, praised by reviewers of color
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Pump dispenser controls product well, little waste
Sits on top of skin without absorbing for some

extraits.titre: Nice texture, wished it sunk in more!
extraits.texte: I really felt like this sat on top of my skin, rather than being absorbed properly. I felt oily, not glowy, and I'm sick of worrying about getting this around the necks of my clothing. Nice texture, but will be returning.

This sunscreen is a lightweight, completely clear serum that goes on smooth and melts instantly into my skin. Because it doesn't use zinc, there is absolutely zero white cast, so I don't have to worry about looking pale or chalky. It leaves behind a very noticeable, radiant satin glow, which is great for my dry areas or when I want a really hydrated base under my makeup. Plus, since it doesn't have that heavy, slippery silicone feel, my foundation sits on top of it beautifully without balling up or flaking off. However, that intense dewiness is a double-edged sword. On oily days, it can easily cross the line into feeling greasy and sticky rather than fresh. I used primer under to help decrease the shine. I also love the packaging! Ultimately, if you want an invisible, glowy primer-moisturizer hybrid and don't mind spending a bit more, it works wonders, but I'd pass on it if you have oilier skin and/or prefer a matte finish. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have enjoyed my experience using the Cabana Clear Serum. I have combination skin that leans very oily this time of the year, and was nervous this would make me greasy, but it didn't at all! The serum gave me a nice glow, and definitely protected me from the very sunny days we've had recently. I think the coverage could be a bit better, but I was still content. If you're looking for something to even out your skin tone, you'll want to layer something over it. The biggest issue for me was that my bottle arrived broken, making it hard to pump out product. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: My skin is obsessed with this sunscreen
extraits.texte: My skin absolutely loves this sunscreen. I have super oily, acne prone skin and thankfully this didn't make me break out or feel greasy at all. It gives my skin such a healthy glowy look instead of that heavy oily feeling. It also sits really well under makeup and doesn't pill or separate throughout the day. Definitely one of the few sunscreens my skin actually enjoys wearing *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is my first time using a sunscreen quite like this. It is a tan color, but almost instantly disappears when I spread it. It spreads very easily and the radiance lets me know if I missed any spots. It feels very lightweight and helps hydrate my dry skin.This is perfect for having an illuminating glow while protecting your skin from sun damage. I don't wear makeup, but love to have an illuminated, healthy glow to my skin.I love a sunscreen that is also skincare and the added glow this gives makes it my new favorite.I received this as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the NAKED SUNDAYS CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 in Illuminating for a week now, and I can honestly say it's one of the nicest SPF products I've tried. Sunscreen is usually the step I dread most in my routine because so many formulas feel greasy, heavy, or leave a white cast, but this one completely surprised me. The texture is incredibly lightweight and truly feels like a water gel serum. It absorbs quickly into the skin and layers beautifully under makeup without pilling.The illuminating finish gives such a healthy glow without looking oily or overly shiny. It makes my skin look fresh and hydrated, especially on days when my complexion feels dull or dry. I also appreciate that it doesn't feel sticky throughout the day, even in warm weather. It gives that "glowy skin" look while still feeling breathable and comfortable.One of the biggest positives for me is that it doesn't irritate my skin or eyes, which is something I struggle with when trying new SPF products. I have combination/sensitive skin, and this formula worked really well for me without causing breakouts or congestion. It also sits nicely over skincare and under foundation, making it easy to wear every single day.Overall, this is an SPF that actually makes me want to apply sunscreen consistently. The combination of high SPF protection, lightweight texture, and radiant finish makes it stand out from many others I've tried.
